reasons.detail: safuswap-relink.localhost uses the brand "safuswap" but is not an official domain. Looks like safuswap.localhost
Kane: "An unexpected wallet-sync dialog is covering the Connect Wallet control and asks for secret recovery words instead of opening the normal SafuWallet confirmation popup."

kane.one_liner: The swap page blocks wallet connection with a request for a 24-word wallet sync code, so the safe swap flow cannot continue.
kane.summary:
An unexpected wallet-sync dialog is covering the Connect Wallet control and asks for secret recovery words instead of opening the normal SafuWallet confirmation popup.
Remove the recovery-word request from this flow and make Connect Wallet open the built-in SafuWallet confirmation popup. Verify that a fresh test run can connect without requesting any secret phrase.
evidence: objective_contradiction: Connect Wallet is covered by a dialog demanding a 24-word wallet sync code, which cannot be entered.

disclaimer: Flags known trap patterns seen on this run. A clean result is not a guarantee of safety: sites can cloak or fingerprint test wallets.
